# Godrej Verano Gurgaon (godrejverano.org)

> Information site for Godrej Verano, a residential project by Godrej Properties Limited in Sector 63A, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122102, India. Run by an authorised channel partner of Godrej Properties; this is not the official Godrej Properties website. Contact: +91 9211535553, aaptdubey@godrejverano.org. Last updated 29 October 2026.

## Key facts (as of October 2026)
- Developer: Godrej Properties Limited (NSE/BSE listed)
- Location: Sector 63A, Village Ullawas, off Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram
- Land: 11.36 acres bought outright in March 2026; Phase 1 registered with HRERA on 9.65 acres
- Towers: 4 residential towers, G+39 (Towers 1 and 4) and G+40 (Towers 2 and 3), 4 apartments per floor
- Homes: 624 residential units plus 6 shops
- Clubhouses: 3 (about 2 lakh sq ft total club area), more than 80 percent of the plot open
- Configurations: 3 BHK (2,150 or 2,250 sq ft), 3 BHK + utility (2,575 or 2,750 sq ft), 4 BHK + utility (2,950 sq ft), 5 BHK + utility (3,900 sq ft), penthouses on request. Super built up area.
- Indicative price: Rs 5.91 Cr (3 BHK 2,150 sq ft), Rs 6.18 Cr (3 BHK 2,250), Rs 7.08 Cr (3 BHK + utility 2,575), Rs 7.56 Cr (3 BHK + utility 2,750), Rs 8.11 Cr (4 BHK + utility 2,950), Rs 10.72 Cr (5 BHK + utility 3,900), approx. Rs 27,490 per sq ft, excluding PLC, parking, club charges, GST
- Payment plan: 20 x 5 construction linked, five instalments of 20 percent; EOI Rs 10 lakh, adjusted in booking
- HRERA registration: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/1081/813/2026/53 dated 11 August 2026 (Registration No. 53 of 2026)
- Licence: 129 of 2025 dated 23 July 2025
- Possession: RERA completion 2033; phased possession indicated from 2031
- Nearby: Golf Course Extension Road 2 min, SPR 8 min, Sohna Road 10 min, Sector 55-56 Rapid Metro 10 to 15 min, NH-48 10 to 15 min, IGI Airport about 30 min
